criterion: When amounts match and all mandatory fields are present, record is auto-cleared
Auto-cleared records display a rule result of MATCH
Mismatch greater than 0.01 is routed to manual review
Matching amounts within 0.01 are not flagged solely for a small rounding difference
Duplicate flag has priority over other validation rules
Duplicate records are never auto-cleared
Blank payment references are routed to manual review
Manual-review output includes an explicit exception reason
Age greater than seven days triggers aged-item review
Exactly seven-day-old matching records can be auto-cleared
Each routed record has exactly one primary exception category
Category totals equal total records processed
Reviewer can distinguish auto-cleared from manual-review items
Exception counts are published in a summary report
Baseline effort is calculated using four minutes per record
Future effort is calculated as five minutes per exception plus 0.1 per auto-clear
All functional rules map to acceptance criteria
RTM lists test coverage for implemented rule groups
Replay input produces identical routing outcomes
Test report highlights failed acceptance tests
Dependency and approval decisions are recorded in project documentation
Change assumptions are documented as simulated rather than deployed
CSV exports include record ID and routing result
Reports present both automated and manual-review counts
All 500 input records are represented in the export
